title: IBIS-AMI SerDes link
description: 16 Gb/s NRZ through IBIS-AMI Tx and Rx models (pf_tx preset, pf_rx CTLE + DFE + CDR) over a 22 dB copper channel

notes.title: IBIS-AMI SerDes link — what this testbench does
lines: TX1 is an IBIS-AMI transmitter (pf_tx, photonflux's open-source
model, loaded through PyAMI): PRBS-15 at 16 Gb/s through its
AMI_GetWave with PCIe preset P7 (pre-shoot + de-emphasis).
CH1 is a 22 dB copper channel at the 8 GHz Nyquist frequency.
RX1 is an IBIS-AMI receiver (pf_rx): adaptive CTLE, AGC, 6-tap
DFE and a bang-bang CDR, with 4 mV rms of input noise.
Run, then open the Link tab: the IBIS-AMI card shows the
statistical eye (Rx AMI_Init on the channel estimated from vrx),
the counted BER from AMI_GetWave's own recovered clock,
bathtubs, and the DFE / CDR / level adaptation trace.
Try TX1 Parameters = tx_preset=4 (no Tx EQ), or
RX1 Parameters = dfe_mode=0, and watch the eye close.
